entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-11
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Announcement: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 10.0.6 - Design package dependency change #38124
    Discussions
  • Preview/daily build nugets no longer reference the correct EF Core repo SHA1 in the nuspec #35696
    Discussions

Updated

  • SQL Server: allow using float[], ReadOnlyMemory<float> and similar instead of SqlVector<float> to represent embeddings #37025
    12.0.0
  • SqlServer: KeyNotFoundException in RewriteOperations when a temporal table is renamed into the model's default schema #38601
    12.0.0
  • Cosmos: equality on a hierarchical partition-key prefix is lifted out of WHERE into the partition hint, forgoing the index and scanning the physical partition #38598
    12.0.0
  • Query translation fails when `Where` references a projection guarded by `child != null && grandChild != null` #38565
    12.0.0
  • Support C# union mapping to JSON #38059
    12.0.0
  • Cosmos: make complex types the default (instead of owned) #37954
    12.0.0
  • The SQL logged by EF doesn't reflect changes made by interceptors #37236
    12.0.0
  • [10 Regression] ExecuteUpdate no longer works within compiled queries #36741
    12.0.0
  • PMC: Set PublishAot=false when building the project #35526
    12.0.0
  • Cosmos SQL query enum array (Contains) to string conversion not working properly #35092
    12.0.0
  • Query optimization compares case sensitively while SqlServer is case insensitive? #34862
    12.0.0
  • Concat on string property Error #33061
    12.0.0
  • EF8 core: filtering by enum doesn't work with TPH and OfType #32865
    12.0.0
  • Sql Server - LINQ Contains returns false positive results for string values larger than column size #32735
    12.0.0
  • Can no longer client-evaluate query with projection involving non-primitive list #32634
    12.0.0
  • EF8 - Regression on Contains query when column collation is not default DB collation #32147
    12.0.0
  • Remove MakeGenericMethod from the query hot path #27437
    12.0.0
  • Query: whole non-entity object from a plain (non-aggregated) LeftJoin/DefaultIfEmpty inner is not nulled on no-match #38608
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix shared type entity type name generattion in model snapshot #38611
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38610

Updated

  • Cosmos: flow transactional batch failures through the execution strategy so they can be retried #38597
  • [release/10.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38607
    Servicing-consider
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • [release/8.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38605
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/9.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38606
    Servicing-consider
